title: Treasury - Compliance and Operations
description:
Brief of role: To support and manage day-to-day treasury operations, including repayment planning, borrowing and limit monitoring, asset allocation, DA payouts, NACH coordination, banking activities, treasury MIS, liquidity risk management, and regulatory/compliance requirements. The role will ensure accurate, timely, and well-controlled treasury transactions , effective utilisation of borrowing facilities, proper reconciliation of financial data, and seamless coordination with banks, internal stakeholders, auditors, and other external agencies. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1.Repayment & Borrowing Management Prepare and maintain repayment schedules covering principal, interest, and other applicable charges. Coordinate with banks and internal teams for timely processing of repayments. Ensure repayment data is accurately recorded and reconciled with books, bank statements, and internal MIS. Monitor upcoming repayment obligations and highlight funding requirements in advance. Support management in effective utilisation and monitoring of borrowing facilities. 
 2. DA Payout & Transaction Management Coordinate DA payouts and ensure timely processing of transactions. Validate transaction calculations and supporting documentation before processing. Coordinate with relevant internal teams and banking partners for transaction closure. Resolve transaction-related discrepancies and queries. Provide necessary support during internal and external audits. 
 3. Treasury MIS & Data Validation Prepare daily, monthly, and periodic Treasury MIS. Maintain MIS covering Borrowings,Repayments,Cash flows,Disbursements,Collection Efficiency,Portfolio cuts,Other key treasury parameters Obtain and validate data from various internal teams. Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of MIS. Reconcile MIS data with books of accounts and relevant source documents. 
 4. Asset Allocation & Reconciliation Monitor allocation of assets against respective funding facilities and transactions. Ensure proper mapping of assets to borrowing/funding arrangements. Conduct periodic reconciliation of asset allocation. Identify and resolve mismatches, excess allocation, or double allocation. Maintain appropriate records and supporting documentation. 
 5. Compliance Management Track and complete monthly and quarterly treasury-related compliance requirements within prescribed timelines. Coordinate with relevant internal teams, banks, auditors, and other stakeholders for required data and documents. Ensure timely submission of certificates, statements, reports, and supporting documents. Maintain a compliance tracker and proactively highlight pending or upcoming requirements. 
 6. Liquidity Risk Management (LRM) Support activities related to Liquidity Risk Management. Assist in preparation and monitoring of liquidity-related reports and data. Track cash inflows and outflows and support assessment of liquidity requirements. Highlight potential liquidity gaps and upcoming funding requirements to the relevant stakeholders. Ensure timely availability and accuracy of data required for LRM reporting. 
 7. NACH Coordination Coordinate with the Operations team for NACH mandate setup and activation. Ensure mandates are processed and made live within defined timelines. Monitor mandate-related issues and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution. Provide ongoing operational support for NACH-related requirements. 
 8. New Bank Account Opening & Banking Operations Assist in opening and activating new bank accounts as per business requirements. Coordinate KYC, documentation, account activation, and related formalities. Maintain appropriate records of bank accounts and ensure correct mapping. Coordinate execution of required documentation for API/banking integrations. Liaise with banks and internal stakeholders for account-related requirements. 
 9. Limit Utilisation Monitoring Monitor sanctioned, utilised, and available limits across various borrowing facilities. Maintain facility-wise limit utilisation records. Ensure timely reporting of utilisation levels to relevant stakeholders. Proactively highlight excess utilisation, low availability, or upcoming limit requirements. Support effective utilisation of available borrowing limits. 
 10. Annexure 1 & Regulatory Reporting Prepare and submit Annexure 1 within prescribed timelines. Validate underlying data before submission. Ensure figures are accurate and reconciled with books of accounts and Treasury MIS. Coordinate with relevant teams for data and supporting documents. Maintain proper records for audit and future reference. 
 11. Audit & Internal Controls Support internal, statutory, lender, and other audits relating to treasury activities. Provide required documents, reconciliations, schedules, and transaction details. Ensure timely closure of audit observations related to treasury operations. Follow established treasury processes, controls, and approval mechanisms. 
 12. Other Treasury Activities Support management in treasury-related analysis, reporting, and decision-making. Undertake any other treasury-related activities or projects assigned from time to time. Continuously identify opportunities to improve treasury processes, controls, reporting, and operational efficiency. 
 Desired Skills :- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in Finance, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification will be an added advantage. Preferred: Strong understanding of treasury operations, banking, borrowings, cash flow, and financial reconciliations. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and financial MIS 2-5 years of relevant experience in Treasury, Finance, Banking, NBFC, or Financial Services.

Key Skills: Management,Risk,Auditing,Treasury,NBFC,Compliance management,Compliance,Monitoring

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Job Title: Compliance Officer Location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat Experience: 8+ years of relevant experience preferred Reports To: CEO / Board of Directors Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary: The Compliance Officer will be responsible for overseeing the organisation compliance framework for its financial services/ finance company activities in GIFT IFSC. The role will support adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, directions, circulars, guidelines and other laws relevant to the entitys authorisation and business activities. The role includes monitoring regulatory developments, maintaining effective internal controls, coordinating regulatory filings and inspections, and advising seniormanagement and the Board on compliance matters. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Monitor compliance with the applicable IFSCA (Finance Company) Regulations, 2021, as amended, and relevant IFSCA circulars, guidelines and directions, based on the entitys approved activities and authorisation. Develop, implement and periodically review compliance policies, procedures, compliance calendars and internal controls to support regulatory and operational requirements. Track regulatory changes and assess their impact on the organisation; coordinate timely implementation of required policy, process and control updates. Coordinate preparation, review and timely submission of regulatory returns, reports, disclosures, applications and other filings required by IFSCA and other applicable authorities. Act as a key point of contact for IFSCA and other relevant regulators; coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, reviews and information requests. Monitor compliance across relevant NBFC / finance company activities, which may include lending, financing, credit, leasing, factoring or other permitted activities, only where covered by the entitys authorisation. Support implementation and monitoring of AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions-screening, customer due diligence and suspicious-transaction escalation controls, where applicable to the entitys business and regulatory obligations. Review business processes and transactions for compliance risks; identify gaps, document findings, recommend corrective actions and follow up on closure. Maintain accurate compliance records, registers, regulatory correspondence, evidence of controls, Board / committee papers and other documentation required under applicable rules. Provide compliance guidance to the CEO, Board, business teams and operational functions on regulatory obligations, governance and conduct matters. Support enterprise risk management and coordinate with risk, legal, finance, operations, internal audit and external advisors on compliance-related matters. Deliver compliance awareness and training to employees and maintain records of attendance and completion. Monitor applicable corporate governance, disclosure, fit-and-proper and senior-management requirements, and escalate material breaches or potential non-compliance promptly. 
 Qualifications: 
 Professional qualification or postgraduate degree/diploma in law, finance, accountancy, commerce, economics, business management or a related discipline. CA, CS, CMA, LLB/LLM or other relevant professional qualifications will be an advantage, depending on the applicable regulatory requirements. Compliance Officer NBFC / Finance Company Page 1 Relevant compliance certifications and knowledge of financial-services regulation are preferred. 
 Experience: 
 8+ years of experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, risk or governance within an NBFC, finance company, bank or other regulated financial-services organisation. Working knowledge of the IFSCA (Finance Company) Regulations and the corporate governance and disclosure requirements applicable to finance companies in GIFT IFSC. Experience handling regulatory reporting, compliance testing, policy reviews, regulatory inspections and remediation tracking. Understanding of AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions, financial crime controls and cross-border financial-services compliance is desirable, where relevant to the business. Experience in GIFT IFSC / international financial services / cross-border transactions will be an advantage. 
 Skills & Competencies: 
 Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple compliance deadlines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for regulatory and senior-stakeholder interactions. Integrity, independence, sound judgement and a strong ethical approach. Ability to work collaboratively with senior management and cross-functional teams. Proficiency in MS Office and compliance tracking, reporting or risk-management tools. 
 Additional Requirements: 
 Ability to work from GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, as required by the role and applicable regulatory requirements. Willingness to support regulatory meetings, reviews and inspections, and travel when required. Must satisfy applicable fit-and-proper, integrity and background-verification requirements. 
 Important Note: 
 This job description is a role profile and should be validated against the organisations specific IFSCA authorisation, permitted activities and current regulatory requirements before publication. An IFSCA-regulated Finance Company in GIFT IFSC may not be legally identical to an NBFC regulated by the Reserve Bank of India in domestic India; use the regulatory framework applicable to the entity.
